technical_and_design_decisions: Implement the channel configuration retrieval API by composing the existing configuration conversion and dependent-field retrieval functions, returning a fully populated config.Channel.

Represent the consortium channel-creation policy as a ConfigValue in the relevant consortium group, and expose an update function that modifies only that value while preserving unrelated configuration.
Add channel-group policy operations following the existing policy APIs for other groups, including add, remove, and retrieval functions with consistent validation and error behavior.
Add separate organization-removal functions for consortium, application, and orderer groups, preserving the distinction between group types and their configuration paths.
Add a dedicated consortium-removal function that removes the selected consortium group and associated configuration entries from the update.
Implement system-channel genesis block creation separately from application-channel creation, producing a channel config group containing orderer and consortium groups but no application group.
Add a package-level GoDoc Overview describing the configtx package, channel configuration structure, configuration groups, values, and policies.

Add SignConfigUpdate and SignConfigUpdateEnvelope capabilities to SigningIdentity, rename the public envelope-signing API to SignConfigUpdateEnvelope, and retain the former name as a compatibility wrapper where practical.
Use existing protobuf types, configuration update builders, validation conventions, serialization helpers, and error-reporting patterns rather than introducing new representations.
Keep changes backward compatible unless an interface extension is required by the specification; update in-repository signing identity implementations and mocks accordingly.
assumptions: The existing Hyperledger Fabric configtx package, protobuf definitions, configuration builders, and test infrastructure are available and compile successfully before the increment begins.
No new cryptographic algorithms, identity providers, protobuf messages, or persistent storage mechanisms are required.
The estimate covers implementation, unit tests, examples, package documentation, formatting, and local build/test verification, but not release management or external deployment.
Existing helper functions already support retrieval of the dependent configuration fields needed to construct a complete config.Channel.
Examples are implemented as Go example tests or updates to existing example_test files and are sufficient to demonstrate the requested APIs.
Tests can use existing mock or test signing identities and configuration fixtures; no external Fabric network is required for the normal verification effort.
Adding methods to SigningIdentity may require updates to all implementations and mocks within the repository, but no out-of-tree consumers need to be migrated as part of this increment.
The most likely effort represents active software development work in work-hours, excluding waiting time, meetings, and calendar scheduling effects.

activities.activity_description: Inspect the existing configtx APIs, configuration group hierarchy, protobuf structures, policy helpers, genesis encoding, signing interfaces, tests, and examples; finalize API shapes and compatibility approach for all user stories.
Add the public function that parses or converts the channel configuration into a fully populated config.Channel using existing dependent-field retrieval helpers, including appropriate error handling.
Add unit tests covering complete channel configuration conversion, nested groups, values, policies, missing or malformed fields, and expected error behavior.
Add the API and configuration mutation logic for updating the default channel-creation policy ConfigValue in an existing consortium group without allowing unrelated configuration changes.

activities.activity_name: Test and demonstrate consortium policy update
activities.activity_description: Add unit coverage for valid and invalid consortium policy updates and update example_test with a representative usage example.

Add functions to add, remove, and retrieve policies in the channel group, including name validation, group lookup, policy conversion, and update construction consistent with existing group policy APIs.

activities.activity_name: Test and demonstrate channel-group policy operations
activities.activity_description: Create unit tests for adding, removing, and retrieving channel policies, including duplicate, missing, and malformed policy cases; update examples to show the new operations.
Add separate removal functions for consortium organizations, application organizations, and orderer organizations, with correct group paths, validation, and config update generation.
Add unit tests for successful and invalid removals across consortium, application, and orderer groups, and update examples to demonstrate each function.
Add a function that removes a selected consortium from the channel configuration, including lookup, validation, update-tree mutation, and error handling.
Add unit tests for successful, missing, and invalid consortium removals and update the examples with representative usage.
Add the API and encoding logic for creating a system-channel genesis block containing the channel config group with orderer and consortium groups, explicitly omitting the application group.

activities.activity_name: Test and demonstrate system-channel genesis creation
activities.activity_description: Add unit tests validating the generated envelope, block structure, group presence and absence, configuration values, and error cases; add a new example demonstrating system-channel genesis creation.
Write and integrate the package Overview documentation explaining the package purpose, common usage, channel structure, groups, values, policies, and configuration updates.

Extend SigningIdentity and affected implementations or mocks with config-update signing support, add SignConfigUpdateEnvelope, rename or wrap the existing envelope-signing function for compatibility, and document the distinction between update signing and envelope signing.

activities.activity_name: Test and document signing API changes
activities.activity_description: Add tests for signatures produced by SignConfigUpdate and SignConfigUpdateEnvelope, compatibility behavior of the previous function name, invalid inputs, and GoDoc or example usage.

Run the complete test suite, add or adjust integration coverage for combined configuration mutations, verify generated protobuf and update structures, perform formatting and static checks, and resolve regressions introduced by interface or API changes.
